comment: Tracks IMS registration metrics for each phone.

variables.name: MIN_REGISTRATION_DURATION_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* Minimal duration of the registration state. * *

Registration state (including changes in capable/available features) with duration shorter * than this will be ignored as they are considered transient states.

variables.name: MAX_EXTRA_MESSAGE_LENGTH
variables.comment:
* Maximum length of the extra message in the termination reason. * *

If the extra message is longer than this length, it will be truncated.

variables.name: PATTERN_UUID
variables.comment: Pattern used to match UUIDs in IMS extra messages for filtering.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_UUID
variables.comment: Replacement for UUIDs.

variables.name: PATTERN_URI
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match URI (e.g. sip, tel) in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

NOTE: this simple pattern aims to catch the most common URI schemes. It is not meant to be * RFC-complaint.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_URI
variables.comment: Replacement for URI.

variables.name: PATTERN_IPV4
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match IPv4 addresses in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

This is a copy of {@code android.util.Patterns.IP_ADDRESS}, which is deprecated and might * be removed in the future.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_IPV4
variables.comment: Replacement for IPv4 addresses.

variables.name: PATTERN_IPV6
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match IPv6 addresses in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

NOTE: this pattern aims to catch the most common IPv6 addresses. It is not meant to be * RFC-complaint or free of false positives.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_IPV6
variables.comment: Replacement for IPv6 addresses.

variables.name: PATTERN_IMEI
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match potential IMEI values in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

This includes segmented IMEI or IMEI/SV, as well as unsegmented IMEI/SV.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_IMEI
variables.comment: Replacement for IMEI.

variables.name: PATTERN_UNSEGMENTED_IMEI_IMSI
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match potential unsegmented IMEI/IMSI values in IMS extra messages for
     * filtering.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_UNSEGMENTED_IMEI_IMSI
variables.comment: Replacement for unsegmented IMEI/IMSI.

variables.name: PATTERN_HOSTNAME
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match hostnames in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

This pattern differs from {@link android.util.Patterns.DOMAIN_NAME} in a few ways: it * requires the name to have at least 3 segments (shorter names are nearly always public or * typos, i.e. missing space after period), does not check the validity of TLDs, and does not * support punycodes in TLDs.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_HOSTNAME
variables.comment: Replacement for hostnames.

variables.name: PATTERN_UNKNOWN_ID
variables.comment:
* Pattern used to match potential IDs in IMS extra messages for filtering. * *

This pattern target numbers that are potential IDs in unknown formats. It should be * replaced after all other replacements are done to ensure complete and correct filtering. * *

Specifically, this pattern looks for any number (including hex) that is separated by dots * or dashes has at least 6 significant digits, and any unsegmented numbers that has at least 5 * significant digits.

variables.name: REPLACEMENT_UNKNOWN_ID
variables.comment: Replacement for potential IDs.

variables.name: mLastAvailableFeatures
variables.comment: Available features are those reported by ImsService to be available for use.

variables.name: mLastWwanCapableFeatures
variables.comment: and not necessarily updated when RAT changes.

This method is also invoked whenever the registration state, feature capability, or * feature availability changes.
